name: tumbite
description: Tumbite: marketplace de reparto de comida (cliente, repartidor, restaurante, paneles y servidor).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tumbite/panel && npm run build -w @tumbite/servidor && npm run build:tiempo-real -w @tumbite/tiempo-real && npm run build:reloj -w @tumbite/tiempo-real
scripts.build:app-web: cd apps/cliente && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=${URL_API:-https://divoox.com} EXPO_PUBLIC_COMMIT=${COMMIT:-local} EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 CI=1 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-web --clear && node scripts/claro.mjs
scripts.build:repartidor-web: cd apps/repartidor && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=${URL_API:-https://divoox.com} EXPO_PUBLIC_COMMIT=${COMMIT:-local} EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 CI=1 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-web --clear && node ../cliente/scripts/claro.mjs dist-web
scripts.build:restaurante-web: cd apps/restaurante && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=${URL_API:-https://divoox.com} EXPO_PUBLIC_COMMIT=${COMMIT:-local} EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 CI=1 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-web --clear && node ../cliente/scripts/claro.mjs dist-web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.recorrido:capturas: node scripts/recorrido/preparar.mjs && CAPTURAS=1 playwright test -c playwright.recorrido.config.ts && node scripts/recorrido/a-docs.mjs
